Key Responsibilities
Design, build, and deploy generative AI models (text, image, code) using Python and frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch .
Fine-tune AI models, optimize hyperparameters, and evaluate performance for quality output.
Integrate AI solutions into existing systems or develop new applications, including cloud deployment for scalability.
Work with leadership and stakeholders to identify AI opportunities and support business strategies.
Develop and maintain large-scale data ecosystems, ensuring data management, governance, and integration.
Build and prioritize backlogs for ML-enabled features.
Stay updated with the latest research, tools, and ethical considerations in generative AI.
Implement automation and cognitive techniques for data insights, prediction, and operational efficiency.
Collaborate across teams to develop standards and best practices for generative AI solutions.
Technical Skills Required
Strong experience in deep learning : PyTorch, TensorFlow, Jax, Ray.
Experience with machine learning APIs and NLP.
Proficiency in Python , API development, and data preprocessing.
Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , Vertex AI, and microservices architecture.
SQL expertise: BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Postgres SQL .
Experience with containerization: Docker, Kubernetes .
Hands-on experience with CI/CD for ML , serverless deployment, and cloud-based ML pipelines.
Familiarity with working on large datasets and applying AI/ML techniques in real-world applications.
Preferred Skills
Experience in computer vision applications for generative AI.
Knowledge of ethical AI development and data privacy standards.
Experience with debugging, troubleshooting, and optimizing AI/ML solutions.

Seeking an AI Prompt Engineer with experience designing, optimizing, and evaluating prompts, system instructions, and interaction workflows for LLM-powered applications. The role involves improving AI output quality, safety, reasoning, and user experience across enterprise AI products and generative AI solutions.

Responsibilities
Design, test, and optimize prompts and system instructions for LLM-based applications and AI workflows.
Build evaluation frameworks to measure prompt quality, response accuracy, safety, and consistency.
Collaborate with AI engineers, product teams, and developers to improve model outputs and user interactions.
Develop prompt libraries, reusable templates, and prompt versioning strategies.
Test prompts across multiple model providers, APIs, and fine-tuned LLM variants.
Support RAG workflows, structured outputs, agentic AI interactions, and conversational AI systems.
Analyze model behavior, hallucinations, edge cases, and response reliability issues.
Document prompt engineering standards, experimentation results, and best practices.
Stay updated with advancements in LLMs, generative AI tooling, evaluation methods, and AI safety practices.
Required Skills
Prompt Engineering LLMs Evaluation Frameworks Python OpenAI Anthropic Claude RAG Generative AI System Prompting AI Workflows Conversational AI Structured Outputs
Preferred Skills
Experience with chain-of-thought prompting, structured output generation, and agentic AI workflows.
Understanding of AI evaluation metrics, red-teaming, hallucination reduction, and responsible AI practices.
Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, vector databases, and LLM orchestration frameworks.
Experience working with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or open-source LLM ecosystems.
Strong analytical thinking, experimentation, and communication skills.
Education: Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Linguistics, or a related field. Hands-on experience building and evaluating AI/LLM applications is highly preferred.
Neotechie

As a Junior AI Engineer, you will contribute to developing AI agents that enhance the meeting and collaboration experience. You will gain hands-on exposure to LLMs, ASR, and applied ML/DL, while building practical engineering skills in optimizing model performance, ensuring output quality, and supporting real- time RTC use cases. This is an exciting opportunity to grow quickly in a fast-paced startup culture where ownership, adaptability, and continuous learning are key.
Key Accountabilities Activities
Assist in developing AI agents using both proprietary (e.g., OpenAI GPT) and open-source LLMs
(e.g., Qwen, Llama).
Implement ASR pipelines to support real-time speech-to-text use cases in meetings.
Contribute to model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and deployment for user-facing features.
Support the creation of QA and evaluation pipelines to monitor model accuracy and output quality.
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to align AI features with the overall product roadmap.
Conduct research on emerging ML/LLM techniques and experiment with integration into product use cases.
Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure reliable AI functionality.




Background, Skills Qualifications
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field.
4+ years of experiences in ML and LLM.
Solid foundation in ML/DL principles and practical coding.
Proficiency in Python (bonus: JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, or Java).
Familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras).
Exposure to LLM use cases and API integration.
Familiarity with ASR tools (e.g., Whisper, Vosk, Kaldi) is a plus.
Basic knowledge of cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure).
Comfortable working in a startup environment adaptive, fast-moving, and proactive.
Strong problem-solving skills, willingness to take ownership, and a growth mindset

Translate business needs into technical solutions.
